question: Does the user-provided Volcengine Ark Agent Plan endpoint accept OpenAI-style multimodal image content parts (chat content array with an image_url data URL) for the candidate models, as the M07 computer-use prerequisite? This fixes the modality matrix only.
source_of_endpoint: user ~/.env VOLCENGINE_BASE_URL (openai-compatible), credential read at runtime from user ~/.env only
credential_handling: Key is read from the user home .env at runtime, used only as a Bearer header, never printed, never written to evidence or logs. Request bodies contain only a deterministically generated test image and fixed probe text; no task data or secrets.
image_provenance: A 32x32 solid-color PNG is generated in-script from zlib/struct with no external assets; its sha256 and byte length are recorded in the evidence record. The image carries no information beyond a fixed color.
method: 1. Generate the fixed PNG once per run and record image_sha256/image_bytes.

2. For each candidate model id in VOLCENGINE_AVAILABLE_MODELS (glm-5.3, deepseek-v4-flash, kimi-k3), send one probe: chat.completions body with n=1, stream=false, max_completion_tokens=2048 (the amendment-001 production budget; smaller budgets are known to truncate reasoning into finish_reason=length), and messages=[{role:'user', content:[{type:'text', text:<fixed one-line question>},{type:'image_url', image_url:{url:'data:image/png;base64,<fixed image>'}}]}].
3. Record raw request/response bytes, http status, usage object, model echo, finish_reason, and the assistant text prefix as observation only.

4. Classify per model: accepted (HTTP 200, object=chat.completion, finish_reason=stop, usage total=prompt+completion), rejected_image_content (HTTP 4xx; capture the exact provider error code and message verbatim as the decisive evidence), inconclusive (5xx, timeout, or transport failure).
5. Answer correctness is NOT a pass criterion; this probe fixes wire-level modality support only. Grounding quality belongs to a later M07 batch.
pass_criteria: accepted=true per model. The M07 image-channel prerequisite is satisfied for a model only when accepted=true; a rejected_image_content classification routes that model to the axtree-first observation path instead.
non_goals: No screen-understanding or grounding claims; no pixel fidelity checks; not M07 evidence; no change to the recorded M01 provider_model baseline.
